title: Use Get tote task to view active tote state and resend a tote task to the robotics database model
summary: Use the OptiSweep/WCS “Get tote task” function to view which totes are currently active, then resend a tote task to the robotics database model when the active tote state needs to be re-issued.
when_to_use: When you need to check the active state of totes via “Get tote task,” and you need to re-issue (resend) a tote task to the robotics database model for a relevant tote.
roles_and_responsibilities: L1_support: Execute the Get tote task check and perform the resend action to the robotics database model for the relevant tote task when required.
access_or_tools_needed: OptiSweep/WCS API access (tote-related functions are referenced in the source).
Robotics database model (the resend action targets the robotics database model).

access_required: OptiSweep/WCS API access to the tote-related functions (Get tote task / resend tote task).

visual_references.description: Frame showing the tote-related API functions list including “GetToteTask” and the statement that you can resend a tote task to the robotics database model.

steps.title: Run or open the Get tote task function to view the active state of the totes
steps.purpose: Confirm which totes are currently active so you can determine whether a tote task needs to be re-issued.
steps.instruction: Use the OptiSweep/WCS tote function labeled “GetToteTask” to view the active state of the totes.
steps.expected_result: The “GetToteTask” output indicates the active state of the totes.
steps.healthy_condition: The Get tote task output clearly reflects which totes are active (i.e., the active state is visible in the Get tote task results).
steps.failure_condition: The Get tote task output does not show the active state you need (e.g., the active state is missing/incorrect for the tote(s) you are investigating).

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get tote task shows the active state of the totes …”

steps.title: Identify the tote(s) whose active state indicates the task status you need to address
steps.purpose: Select the specific tote(s) that require a resend based on the active state shown by Get tote task.
steps.instruction: From the “GetToteTask” results, identify the tote(s) whose active state indicates the tote task status you need to address.
steps.expected_result: You have identified the specific tote(s) that require a resend action.
steps.healthy_condition: The tote(s) selected correspond to the active-state information shown in the Get tote task output.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confidently map the tote(s) you need to address to the active-state information shown in Get tote task.

actions.label: Select tote(s) from GetToteTask output
actions.exact_action: Identify the tote(s) whose active state indicates the task status you need to address

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “Get tote task shows the active state of the totes …”

steps.title: Resend a tote task to the robotics database model for the relevant tote task
steps.purpose: Re-issue the tote task to the robotics database model for the tote(s) that need the task state corrected.
steps.instruction: Use the resend capability described for tote tasks to resend the tote task to the robotics database model for the relevant tote task.
steps.expected_result: The resend action re-issues the tote task to the robotics database model for the selected tote task.
steps.healthy_condition: After the resend action, the tote task has been re-issued to the robotics database model (i.e., the resend operation completes as intended for the selected tote task).
steps.failure_condition: Resending does not change the active state as expected.

actions.label: Resend tote task to robotics database model
actions.exact_action: resend a tote task to robotics database model

stop_or_escalate_if: If resending does not change the active state as expected, stop and escalate for deeper robotics/database troubleshooting.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: “You can resend a tote task to robotics database model.”

success_criteria: Get tote task output shows the active state of the totes.
Resend action re-issues the tote task to the robotics database model for the relevant tote task.
healthy_conditions: GetToteTask results display the active state of totes.
Resend operation completes and the active state reflects the re-issued tote task as expected.
failure_conditions: Get tote task does not provide the active state information needed for the tote(s) under investigation.
Resending does not change the active state as expected.
escalation_guidance: If resending does not change the active state as expected, stop and escalate for deeper robotics/database troubleshooting.
